version_findings.finding: Main V2 is preview (docs pin2.0.0a3), with limited indoor assets/materials and simple room arrangements; not a ready whole-town generator.
Main pyproject requires Python==3.11.*, bpy==4.2.0, procfunc>=0.37,<0.38 and NumPy<2; terrain and simulator exporters remain legacy v1 extras.
Documented native Windows support is experimental for minimal assets, unsupported for legacy CPU terrain; WSL2 terrain is experimental.

cherry_pick_matrix.mechanism: Stable seeded asset factories and coarse placeholders
cherry_pick_matrix.adaptation: Give each town object a stable ID and derived sub-seed; solve envelopes first, then replace with detailed existing cafe/reserve asset factories. Preserve transform and material contracts.

Separate hard room/portal/walkway/collision constraints from soft composition. Add own Breton cafe, bathhouse, shop, trailer and town-program rules; do not assume generic home constraints encode commercial circulation.

Use inward-facing chairs with dimension-aware spacing and tucking; propagate table rotation; reject colliding arrangements with bounded retries. Add explicit player navigation clearance beyond intersection tests.
Allocate mesh/texel density from projected size and importance, using the union of walkable areas and walkthrough routes; never permanently cull playable off-camera content.
Scatter linked plant prototypes by ecological zones, slope, moisture and exclusions, preserving clearings and trails; record instance transforms separately for engine import.
Use height and upward-normal masks plus patch noise; keep town-specific road/structure/water-bank exclusions and horticultural beds authoritative.

cherry_pick_matrix.mechanism: Layered material composition with physical displacement
cherry_pick_matrix.adaptation: Keep the fine CC0 source scan, add context-specific paint/wear masks at physical scales, and bake conventional PBR channels. Retain maintained pale limewash rather than random cracked surfaces.

Keep own chunked GLB exporter and source-bound PBR verification. Upstream exporter warns procedural baking is lossy and large realized instance exports can exceed memory; full-scene support is USDC in that exporter, not a claim that glTF cannot instance.

licensing.component: Infinigen root and inspected candidate factory/placement/shader files
licensing.action: Retain copyright, conditions, disclaimer and modification provenance for actual code adaptation.
Separate from permissive code path; review if redistributing authoring code.
Wrapper calls require_blender_addon(...allow_online=True). Pin extension and notices before using; do not allow silent downloads or call entire dependency chain BSD.
Keep its separate notice if adopted.
Examples are not CC0 or automatically covered by root BSD. Prefer existing owned/CC0 assets; do not fetch these just to run a tutorial.

recommended_one_command_design: One command executes a resumable deterministic DAG: brief/style/seed -> terrain/water -> street/parcel graph -> room/portal graph -> coarse placement checks -> detailed assets -> physical PBR bakes -> instanced chunks/LODs -> matched review views -> native/GLB and isolated consumers. One command is orchestration, not one unchecked random pass.
compatibility_boundary: Reuse ideas in native Blender5.2 code first. Any actual Infinigen generation should be an optional pinned isolated Python3.11/bpy4.2 worker, preferably Linux/WSL for terrain; pass static meshes/maps through disk. No demonstrated compatibility or output quality on this AMDWindows host.
